necro-tetris-mcp.description: Model Context Protocol bridge allowing external Kiro agents to inspect board matrix, calculate optimal moves, and cast Battle Gaiden curses.

tools.name: get_board_state
tools.description: Returns current 10x20 matrix representation, active piece, hold piece, and active curses.

tools.name: suggest_move
tools.description: Uses Dellacherie heuristics to recommend the best rotation and target column for the active tetromino.

tools.name: cast_curse
tools.description: Allows the Poltergeist agent to trigger a specific curse (fog_of_war, poltergeist_shift, soul_inversion, tombstone_crumble).

tools.name: get_graveyard_stats
tools.description: Returns lifetime score, total lines cleared (exorcised), back-to-back count, and curse survival rate.
